description: Bootstrap gives you ready-made CSS styles for a web page. It is like a box of craft pieces: you can choose a button, a card or a row of boxes and put them together. Learn a little HTML and CSS first. Then add Bootstrap class names to your page. Some moving parts also need Bootstrap's JavaScript. The setup lesson explains which files to use.
versionNote: Targets Bootstrap 5.3 (2026), the current 5.x line with colour modes; notes point out where Bootstrap 3 and 4 syntax differs.
whatYouWillLearn: Use class names to style buttons and text
Make rows of boxes that fit different screens
Know when a Bootstrap part needs JavaScript too
learningObjectives: Use class names to style buttons and text
Make rows of boxes that fit different screens
Know when a Bootstrap part needs JavaScript too

seo.title: Bootstrap Tutorial – Learn Bootstrap 5.3 Step by Step
seo.description: Free Bootstrap 5.3 tutorial for beginners: setup, grid and breakpoints, typography, buttons, forms, navbar, cards, modals, utilities, dark mode and Sass customisation.
